title: Circular Celestials
description: Ports the circular sun and moon from b1.9 pre4 to newer versions.
body:
Remember when Mojang made the sun and moon round? No? Well I did, I've remembered ever since.
And if you did remember, then you either loved it or hated it.

This resource pack ports over the circular sun and moon from Beta 1.9 Pre-release 4.

![The sun over a small hill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/572942051f3f887398b002ceafbb6660f1577383.png)

![Moon at Last Quarter rising over an unfinished house](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9268c01573d33f4f1eeb47da2e0803aec2c2651_0.webp)

You are free to use this in a modpack, no need to ask for permission!
